pages.text: The $(item)Tent$() is a two-block-tall decorative block that serves as a personal portal to a private $(thing)glamping dimension$(). Each tent leads to its own unique pocket of wilderness — your cosy home away from home.

pages.title: Placement & Use
pages.text: Place the Tent like a bed — it occupies two blocks in the direction you face. $(bold)Right-click$() to teleport to your private camp.$(br2)Right-clicking the tent door from inside the glamping dimension returns you to the overworld at your departure point.$(br2)The camp is a pre-generated 16×16 space with a placed tent-door structure. Breaking and re-placing the tent returns you to the exact same camp each time.

pages.title: Named Tents
pages.text: Rename the Tent with an $(item)Anvil$() before placing it. The custom name seeds the camp location — two tents with the same name lead to the same camp, which is great for building a shared base.$(br2)The custom name is preserved when the tent is broken and picked up, so you can move it without losing your camp.
